basis: Latest Operator decisions in this conversation; later decisions replace earlier conflicting proposals.

root_entities.name: Artifact
root_entities.meaning: One governed lifecycle unit containing named dependent Entities.
root_entities.lifecycle: The Artifact has one lifecycle; its dependent Entities do not have separate lifecycles.

narrower_entities.name: Atom
narrower_entities.meaning: An Entity made of named dependent Entities, informally called sub-atoms.

root_entities.name: Scope Unit
root_entities.meaning: Organizes and owns Atoms and other Scope Units; sits outside any individual Atom.
root_entities.nesting: Recursive Scope Unit nesting is allowed.

root_entities.name: Relation
root_entities.note: This is the Operator's inter-Atom relation family. Internal property qualification is distinguished from the Property node it connects.

root_entities.name: Revision
root_entities.meaning: A historical snapshot of an Artifact.
root_entities.history_connection: Revision of an Artifact; no new native relation kind is admitted by this candidate.
root_entities.recursion_boundary: Revision is not itself an Artifact subject to another Artifact revision rule.

root_entities.name: Carrier
root_entities.meaning: What carries or stores an Entity's representation.
root_entities.placement: Separate root Entity, not a Property.

root_entities.name: Execution
root_entities.meaning: One actual run of an Operation.
root_entities.definition_boundary: The Operation definition and its actual Execution are distinct.

dependent_entities.meaning: Named Entities inside an Artifact, including Properties.
dependent_entities.property_node_vs_relation: A Property is a dependent Entity node; property-of is the relation connecting it to its owning Entity.
dependent_entities.notation_boundary: Compact examples are candidate display notation, not admission of native edges or permission to migrate Subjects.

snapshot_and_history_rules: Entities and Properties describe the selected snapshot.
Across all non-archived folders combined, at most one Atom may carry a given Atom ID.
The uniqueness boundary includes Active, Done, Backlog, Canceled and other non-archived status containers.
Archived snapshots may retain the same Atom ID.
Drafts remain without assigned Atom IDs.
Archive preserves previous snapshots; Journal records changes.
A new Updated At can distinguish a new historical state; no separate Applicable Methodology Revision or Projection Revision kind is formalized here.
Revision is a separate historical root, not an Artifact subtype or an IS_BORNE_BY child of Artifact or Atom.

content_direction.scope_omission: Substance Scope may be omitted only for the whole governed Subject AND the whole owning Scope Unit; either restriction requires explicit Scope.
content_direction.details: General Details are optional; role/type-required content is not silently removed.

applicable_methodology.form: A reconciled Projection materialized as projected Atoms, not necessarily one document.
applicable_methodology.requirement: Select applicable source Atoms, resolve conflicts and check coherence before publishing a consistent projected Atom set.
applicable_methodology.authority: Source Atoms remain authoritative; the projected set does not create new authoritative Atom identities.
applicable_methodology.root_status: Not an additional independent root in this candidate.

m_e_root_question.decision: M and E are role-centred views over the shared roots: their specifications are Atoms; actual performances or checks are Executions.
m_e_root_question.alternative_not_selected: Add separate Method or Evaluation conceptual roots.
